title: bouch-web
summary: Portable, evidence-tiered web design knowledge for Bouch web work. Consult alongside the Web Workbench for visual direction, typography, component and interaction-state coverage, reference-site research, asset and licence boundaries, and human screenshot critique. The package includes one narrow typography Skill and references; the Workbench remains the authoritative rendered-output instrument. Fixture evidence is bounded and does not select a final typeface or turn taste prompts into automated gates.

source.note: Promoted experimental web-design knowledge package. Evidence and open limits are recorded in evidence/qualification.md; use with dev.bouch/web-workbench for rendered verification.
